objections.claim: D-048 states the post-dependent overturn procedure required once an owner-recorded DR-004 Route B disposition exists.
objections.evidence: D-048 lines 80-83 authorizes a future reviewed, owner-recorded disposition to discharge condition 1 within its scope, but lines 96-98 define reversibility only before dependents and then name C-D048 alone. Reverting or superseding only D-048 after that disposition lands would leave the independently live disposition in place and would not return DR-004 to D-001's default Route A posture. D-047 lines 57-59 already states the missing rule, and adopted D-028/D-029 preserve the same temporal dependency boundary.
objections.proposedFix: Mirror D-047 and the adopted precedent: say that before a dependent disposition lands, supersession plus revert of C-D048 is total; after one lands, overturn also requires that disposition's Evidence/retention-authority supersession or revert. Require every future DR-004 disposition relying on D-048 to name D-048 as a dependency and carry its own rollback. Keep D-047 and D-048 independently overturnable.
